label: Bank competition and concentration
query: (bank OR banks OR banking OR lender OR lenders OR mortgage OR mortgages OR deposit OR deposits) AND (competition OR concentration OR "market share" OR switching)

label: Mortgage arrears and distressed debt
query: mortgage AND (arrears OR restructuring OR repossession OR forbearance)

label: Mortgage switching and refinancing
query: mortgage AND (switching OR refinance OR refinancing OR cashback)

label: SME finance and credit access
query: (SME OR "small business" OR "small and medium enterprises") AND (credit OR lending OR finance OR funding)

label: Credit unions
query: "credit union" OR "credit unions"

label: Consumer harm and vulnerability
query: (consumer OR customer) AND (harm OR vulnerable OR vulnerability OR detriment OR exploitation)

label: Fraud, scams and payment deception
query: fraud OR fraudulent OR scam OR scams OR phishing OR smishing OR vishing OR impersonation OR "money mule" OR "money mules" OR "authorised push payment" OR "authorized push payment"

label: AML, CFT and financial crime controls
query: AML OR "money laundering" OR "terrorist financing" OR sanctions

label: Regulatory reporting burden and quality
query: (reporting OR returns OR submission) AND (burden OR manual OR error OR quality OR reconciliation OR duplication)

label: Data quality and fragmentation
query: "data quality" OR "data governance" OR "data gap" OR "fragmented data"

label: Authorisation and licensing
query: authorisation OR authorization OR licensing OR "application process"

label: Operational resilience and outsourcing
query: "operational resilience" OR outsourcing OR "third party risk" OR "third-party risk" OR "critical third party" OR "business continuity" OR DORA

label: Cybersecurity and ICT risk
query: cybersecurity OR cyber OR "ICT risk" OR ransomware

label: Payments and electronic money
query: payments OR "electronic money" OR "e-money" OR "payment institution"

label: Open banking and data portability
query: "open banking" OR PSD2 OR AISP OR PISP OR "account information service" OR "payment initiation service" OR "data portability"

label: Cash access and infrastructure
query: cash AND (access OR ATM OR infrastructure OR acceptance OR withdrawal)

label: Financial inclusion and basic access
query: "financial inclusion" OR "basic bank account" OR unbanked OR exclusion

label: Insurance affordability and protection gaps
query: insurance AND (affordability OR availability OR exclusion OR "protection gap")

label: Climate and financial risk
query: climate AND (risk OR insurance OR lending OR finance OR transition OR physical)

label: Funds and asset management
query: UCITS OR AIF OR "investment fund" OR "fund management company"

label: Financial literacy and consumer understanding
query: "financial literacy" OR "financial education" OR "consumer understanding"

label: Complaints and consumer redress
query: complaints OR redress OR remediation OR compensation

label: Legacy technology and manual processes
query: "legacy system" OR "legacy systems" OR "manual process" OR spreadsheets

label: Housing, mortgages and credit supply
query: housing AND (mortgage OR credit OR lending OR affordability OR supply)
